## Starward (星之翼) Cheats — iOS Mod Menu

**Target Bundle ID:** `com.networkcentury.xzy`  
**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

### 🔥 Tab 1 — Damage (`Outgoing Damage Control`)
- **One-Hit Kill** — Instantly eliminates any hit enemy (`HitComponent.HpPhase` / `HpComponent.ChangeHp`)
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiplies all outgoing damage dealt to enemies
- **Max Outgoing Damage Ratio** — Boosts `HpComponent.GetHpOutDamageUp` curve ratio

### ❤️ Tab 2 — HP & Shield (`Player Invincibility`)
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Blocks all incoming damage, `MinusPoint`, `MinusRatio` & `Dead` triggers
- **Auto Lock Full HP** — Locks player `mHp` (`+0x58`) to `MaxHp` (`+0x48`)
- **Infinite Shield Absorb** — Player `ShieldComponent` never loses absorb capacity

### 🤖 Tab 3 — Enemy & AI (`AiComponent Control`)
- **Dumb Enemies (Freeze AI)** — Disables `AiComponent.OnUpdate`, `RunAi` & `ExecuteNewAi`
- **Bypass Enemy Shields** — Disables enemy `ShieldComponent.CheckHitAbsorb`
- **Freeze Enemy HP (Combo Practice)** — Enemies take `0` damage so you can practice combos freely

### ⚡ Tab 4 — Ammo & Boost (`AmmoComponent & BoostComponent`)
- **Unlimited Ammo & Ex Skills** — Prevents ammo deduction & refills `FullAmmos` / `FullExAmmos`
- **Infinite Boost / Flight Gauge** — Locks `BoostComponent` flight/dash gauge to `MaxBoost`

### 🚀 Tab 5 — Speed & FPS (`Engine Control`)
- **Game Speed Multiplier (`1.0x – 5.0x`)** — Accelerates gameplay time scale
- **Target Frame Rate (`30 / 60 / 90 / 120 FPS`)** — Unlocks maximum rendering FPS

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves updated offsets across game updates without waiting for a new `.deb`
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

**v3.3.0**
- Initial release for Starward-Mecha Girls / 星之翼 (`com.networkcentury.xzy` v3.3.0)
- Added 31 IL2CPP Auto-Offset resolvers + 1-User Device Token Lock & custom floating icon
